description: This file implements the DolbyOutputImplementation class, which manages Dolby output settings and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes methods for registering/unregistering notifications, querying metadata, and setting audio modes.

classes.name: DolbyOutputImplementation
classes.description: Implements the Exchange::Dolby::IOutput interface to manage Dolby output notifications and settings.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for Dolby output events.

methods.name: AtmosMetadata
methods.description: Queries if Atmos metadata is supported.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Gets the current audio output mode.
